Package index

The Skellam distribution

Density, distribution function, quantile function and random generation, with saddlepoint approximations to the density and distribution function.

dskellam() dskellam.sp() pskellam() pskellam.sp() qskellam() rskellam()
The Skellam Distribution

Moments and generating functions

Theoretical moments and cumulants of any order, and the moment, characteristic and probability generating functions.

skellam.moments() print(<skellam_moments>) skellam.mgf() skellam.cf() skellam.pgf()
Moments and Generating Functions of the Skellam Distribution

Estimation

Fitting the distribution to a sample of differences, and regression with covariates on both rates.

skellam.fit() print(<skellam_fit>) summary(<skellam_fit>) coef(<skellam_fit>) vcov(<skellam_fit>) logLik(<skellam_fit>) nobs(<skellam_fit>) confint(<skellam_fit>) predict(<skellam_fit>) simulate(<skellam_fit>)
Fit the Skellam Distribution to a Sample
skellam.reg()
Skellam Regression
print(<skellam_reg>) summary(<skellam_reg>) coef(<skellam_reg>) vcov(<skellam_reg>) logLik(<skellam_reg>) nobs(<skellam_reg>) fitted(<skellam_reg>) residuals(<skellam_reg>) predict(<skellam_reg>) simulate(<skellam_reg>) anova(<skellam_reg>)
Methods for Skellam Regression Fits

Goodness of fit

Testing whether a sample comes from a Skellam distribution.

skellam.test()
Goodness-of-Fit Test for the Skellam Distribution

Diagnostic plots

Rootograms, PIT histograms and quantile-residual plots comparing data with a fit, and the package’s ggplot2 theme and colours.

plot(<skellam_fit>) plot(<skellam_reg>) autoplot(<skellam_fit>) autoplot(<skellam_reg>)
Diagnostic Plots for Skellam Fits
skellam_palette() theme_skellam() scale_colour_skellam() scale_fill_skellam()
Colours and Theme for skellam Plots
